subject: Request for temporary performance carveout & commercial offset — NorthStar pilot
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen@northstarlabs.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Tom Bishop <tom.bishop@northstarlabs.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot request: temporary performance carveout + commercial offset

Connor —

Thanks for the productive demo last week. We're ready to start a 3-month pilot but need two non-standard items to make this viable on our side: a temporary relaxation of the uptime target to 99.5% (we understand Redwood's standard is 99.9%) and a commercial offset (we're targeting ~30% off list during pilot to fund integration and validation).

Key context:
- Pilot will be multi-tenant ingestion at modest volume (avg 15 qps) but with bursts that have driven up token costs in our PoC.
- Security sheet and MAP attached.
- Our procurement window is tight — need agreement by next Wednesday to meet Q3 pilot kickoff.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can make a short-term concession on the uptime target and a commercial offset for the pilot? If needed, we can sign a limited-term amendment and accept narrower remedies (cap on service credits).

Ellen
Ellen Park
Head of Platform
NorthStar Labs

Attachments: northstar_security_sheet.pdf, northstar_mutual_action_plan.xlsx

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen@northstarlabs.com>, Tom Bishop <tom.bishop@northstarlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot request: temporary performance carveout + commercial offset

Hi Ellen —

Appreciate the quick follow-up and attachments. I'm looping Marissa (deal lead) and will escalate internally for a commercial decision. Short answer: it's something we can consider with guardrails (timebox the change, limit remedy exposure, and require an agreed MAP).

I'll circulate a proposed approach within our deal desk and aim to get back by EOD tomorrow. Can you confirm the exact pilot start date and whether NorthStar will be the only early customer on this pilot? That helps us size approval.

Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 14:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot request: temporary performance carveout + commercial offset — NorthStar (approval requested)

Team —

Forwarding NorthStar's ask. They want: (1) temporary uptime relaxation to 99.5% for the 3-month pilot, (2) ~30% commercial offset for pilot. Proposed commercial structure (my recommendation):
- Pilot term: 90 days, start target 2027-07-01 (NorthStar preference).
- Temporary uptime: 99.6% (middle ground) for pilot only, with remedies capped at 10% of pilot fees and no recurring credit beyond pilot term.
- Commercial offset: 25% off list for pilot (to be amortized in first invoice), with requirement to sign MAP and post-pilot review to convert to production pricing.
- Security docs attached; legal will need to add amendment language limiting long-term exposure.

Why this is urgent: deal slips if we don't provide a clear yes/no by next Wed 6/14. NorthStar is strategic for our healthcare connectors roadmap and could expand rapidly if the pilot shows parity.

What I need from you:
- Jonas: confirm whether 25% + remedy cap is acceptable operationally and any additional guardrails.
- Lauren: draft minimal amendment language that limits remedy exposure and requires conversion review.
- Sean: executive sign-off if we land on the above commercial terms.

Attaching: northstar_security_sheet.pdf, northstar_mutual_action_plan.xlsx, proposed_terms_draft.pdf

Connor

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot request: temporary performance carveout + commercial offset — NorthStar (approval requested)

Connor / all —

Operational perspective: we can accept a temporary uptime of 99.6% for a bounded pilot provided the following are in place:
- Remedy cap: service credits capped at 10% of pilot fees, not to exceed a fixed dollar cap ($12,000) — this prevents open-ended exposure.
- Monitoring: NorthStar must opt-in to our enhanced tracing for pilot to help diagnose burst issues (logs + latency dashboards).
- Auto-fallback: we require fallback routing policy defined in MAP so we can throttle/burst to lower-cost variants without SLA exposure.

Commercial: 25% offset is at the high end but defensible for a pilot with strategic ROI. Finance asks that discounts above 20% get VP-level approval. If we formalize the above guardrails and add a clear production conversion clause, I'm comfortable recommending exec sign-off.

Jonas
Head of Deal Desk Operations

Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot request: temporary performance carveout + commercial offset — NorthStar (approval requested)

Connor / team —

I approve the pilot terms with the following executive conditions:
1) Commercial offset: authorize up to 25% off list for the 90-day pilot.
2) Temporary uptime: permit 99.6% for pilot only.
3) Remedy exposure: cap service credits at 10% of pilot fees and no more than $12,000 total.
4) Legal: Lauren to produce a 1-page amendment capturing timebox + conversion review + monitoring requirement.
5) Finance: Marissa to confirm invoicing schedule and that the discount is amortized on the pilot invoice.

Connor, please confirm with NorthStar and get countersigned amendment. Once signed, ops will enable the monitoring hooks and deal desk will log the concession as a precedent.

—Sean Gallagher
VP, Commercial Strategy | Redwood Inference
